title: Trust Account Opening Package
description: Trust Account Opening Package contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-trust-account-opening-package
  title: Trust Account Opening Package
  description: Trust Account Opening Package contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_trust_account_opening_package_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/trust_account_opening_package
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/trust_account_opening_package
    sourceVersion: fs_trust_account_opening_package_v1
    sourceDigest: 004a6398ca97a1e761afa0d7c6369bdba9db50ffe6f69e02d005096a74833d83
spec:
  role: start
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Trust Account Opening Package
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: application-date
              name: application_date
              label: Application Date
              description: Date the account package was completed.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: trust-type
              name: trust_type
              label: Trust Type
              description: Revocable, irrevocable, testamentary, estate, charitable, special needs, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: jurisdiction
              name: jurisdiction
              label: Jurisdiction
              description: Governing state or country.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: fiduciary-powers
              name: fiduciary_powers
              label: Fiduciary Powers
              description: Investment, distribution, borrowing, pledge, or other powers.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: investment-objective
              name: investment_objective
              label: Investment Objective
              description: Investment objective or account purpose.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: source-of-funds
              name: source_of_funds
              label: Source Of Funds
              description: Source of initial funding.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: account-type-requested
              name: account_type_requested
              label: Account Type Requested
              description: Trust brokerage, fiduciary checking, estate account, managed account, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: document-checklist
              name: document_checklist
              label: Document Checklist
              description: Documents received or required.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: trust-tax-id-masked
              name: trust_tax_id_masked
              label: Trust Tax Id Masked
              description: Masked trust EIN or tax identifier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: initial-deposit-amount
              name: initial_deposit_amount
              label: Initial Deposit Amount
              description: Initial deposit or transfer amount.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: tax-certification-status
              name: tax_certification_status
              label: Tax Certification Status
              description: W-9, W-8, exempt, missing, or other tax certification status.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: trust-name
              name: trust_name
              label: Trust Name
              description: Legal name of trust or estate.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: grantor-names
              name: grantor_names
              label: Grantor Names
              description: Grantors, settlors, or decedent names.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: trustee-names
              name: trustee_names
              label: Trustee Names
              description: Trustees or personal representatives.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              required: true
              span: 2
            - id: authorized-signer-names
              name: authorized_signer_names
              label: Authorized Signer Names
              description: Authorized account signers.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: beneficiary-names
              name: beneficiary_names
              label: Beneficiary Names
              description: Named beneficiaries when present.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: beneficial-ownership-required
              name: beneficial_ownership_required
              label: Beneficial Ownership Required
              description: Whether beneficial ownership certification is required or referenced.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
            - id: relationship-manager-name
              name: relationship_manager_name
              label: Relationship Manager Name
              description: Advisor, banker, or relationship manager.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: risk-tolerance
              name: risk_tolerance
              label: Risk Tolerance
              description: Conservative, moderate, aggressive, or stated risk profile.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: approval-status
              name: approval_status
              label: Approval Status
              description: Approved, pending, rejected, conditional, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: trust-name-present
      severity: error
      description: trust_name is required for Trust Account Opening Package extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: trust_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: trust_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: trust_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(trust_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: trustee-names-present
      severity: error
      description: trustee_names is required for Trust Account Opening Package extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: trustee_names
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: trustee_names
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: trustee_names IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(trustee_names) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: initial-deposit-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: initial_deposit_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: initial_deposit_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: initial_deposit_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: initial_deposit_amount IS NULL OR initial_deposit_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      trust_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Trust Account Opening Package workflow.
      trust_tax_id_masked:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Trust Account Opening Package workflow.
      trustee_names:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Trust Account Opening Package workflow.
      initial_deposit_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Trust Account Opening Package workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Trust Account Opening Package documents combine structured fields and narrative
      risk/legal/compliance context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      application_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the account package was completed.
        format: date
      trust_name:
        type: string
        description: Legal name of trust or estate.
      trust_type:
        type: string
        description: Revocable, irrevocable, testamentary, estate, charitable, special needs, or other.
      trust_tax_id_masked:
        type: string
        description: Masked trust EIN or tax identifier.
      jurisdiction:
        type: string
        description: Governing state or country.
      grantor_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Grantors, settlors, or decedent names.
      trustee_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Trustees or personal representatives.
      authorized_signer_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Authorized account signers.
      beneficiary_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Named beneficiaries when present.
      fiduciary_powers:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Investment, distribution, borrowing, pledge, or other powers.
      investment_objective:
        type: string
        description: Investment objective or account purpose.
      risk_tolerance:
        type: string
        description: Conservative, moderate, aggressive, or stated risk profile.
      source_of_funds:
        type: string
        description: Source of initial funding.
      initial_deposit_amount:
        type: number
        description: Initial deposit or transfer amount.
      account_type_requested:
        type: string
        description: Trust brokerage, fiduciary checking, estate account, managed account, or other.
      tax_certification_status:
        type: string
        description: W-9, W-8, exempt, missing, or other tax certification status.
      beneficial_ownership_required:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether beneficial ownership certification is required or referenced.
      document_checklist:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Documents received or required.
      approval_status:
        type: string
        description: Approved, pending, rejected, conditional, or other.
      relationship_manager_name:
        type: string
        description: Advisor, banker, or relationship manager.
    required:
      - trust_name
      - trustee_names
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - trust_name
            - trustee_names
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
